objective: Calibrate or reject only the public-observable components of the deterministic shadow execution assumptions without credentials, orders, signer access, wallets, or capital.
qualification_rules: Persist exact parsed public payloads and SHA-256 hashes for every HTTP response with request start, receive, provider source, and observation timestamps.

Classify the bundle VALID only when the book provider timestamp is post-preregistration, timestamps are ordered, the product is online and trade-enabled, book sequence is present, both sides are nonempty, best bid is below best ask, and age thresholds pass.
Compute quoted spread and deterministic depth-walk VWAP/slippage for both sides at each frozen test quantity using Decimal arithmetic and no randomness.
Compare price increment, base increment, and minimum market funds with configured assumptions as observed venue facts.
Do not qualify account-tier fees, order latency, rejection probability, partial-fill probability, or actual fill truth from public REST data; report them UNAVAILABLE_FOR_QUALIFICATION.
A successful capture may calibrate individual assumption fields but cannot promote capital eligibility, live readiness, or strategy edge.
failure_rules: Any endpoint requires authentication, returns malformed data, exceeds the frozen size bound, or lacks required provenance.
The provider timestamp is not prospective, the book is crossed/empty, product trading is disabled, quality is not VALID, or immutable persistence/integrity/rebuild fails.
Any order, account, credential, signer, wallet, balance, or capital surface is accessed.
